cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(NOT COMMAND lmx_c99_target)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "The kann group requires lmx_c99_target")
endif()
if(NOT TARGET LMX::zlib)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Initialize the collection's LMX::zlib before the kann group")
endif()
set(_kann_vendor "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}/kann")
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/KANNCompat.cmake")
set(THREADS_PREFER_PTHREAD_FLAG TRUE)
find_package(Threads QUIET)
set(_kann_use_pthreads FALSE)
if(NOT CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_Threads AND Threads_FOUND AND CMAKE_USE_PTHREADS_INIT)
    set(_kann_use_pthreads TRUE)
endif()

# Full upstream CPU core, including all graph operators and RNN/CNN layers.
# No external CBLAS and no -march=native/AVX options. Upstream selects SIMD
# only when the compiler already advertises that target's baseline ISA.
add_library(lmx_kann STATIC "${_kann_view}/kann.c" "${_kann_view}/kautodiff.c")
add_library(LMX::kann ALIAS lmx_kann)
target_include_directories(lmx_kann PUBLIC "${_kann_view}")
if(_kann_use_pthreads)
    target_compile_definitions(lmx_kann PRIVATE HAVE_PTHREAD=1)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_kann PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
else()
    message(STATUS "KANN: using the upstream serial backend (no POSIX pthreads)")
endif()
if(UNIX)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_kann PUBLIC m)
endif()
lmx_c99_target(lmx_kann)
set_target_properties(lmx_kann PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

# Original text/gzip training-data helper, using the SAME bundled zlib.
add_library(lmx_kann_data STATIC "${_kann_view}/kann_extra/kann_data.c")
add_library(LMX::kann_data ALIAS lmx_kann_data)
target_include_directories(lmx_kann_data PUBLIC "${_kann_view}")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_kann_data PRIVATE HAVE_ZLIB=1)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_definitions(lmx_kann_data PRIVATE fileno=_fileno strdup=_strdup)
else()
    target_compile_definitions(lmx_kann_data PRIVATE _POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L)
endif()
target_link_libraries(lmx_kann_data PUBLIC LMX::zlib)
lmx_c99_target(lmx_kann_data)
set_target_properties(lmx_kann_data PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

add_library(lmx_mlp_kann INTERFACE)
add_library(LMX::mlp_kann ALIAS lmx_mlp_kann)
target_link_libraries(lmx_mlp_kann INTERFACE LMX::kann LMX::kann_data)

if(BUILD_TESTING)
    foreach(_test forward_gradient train_serialize data_io)
        add_executable(lmx_kann_test_${_test} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/${_test}.c")
        lmx_c99_target(lmx_kann_test_${_test})
        target_link_libraries(lmx_kann_test_${_test} PRIVATE LMX::mlp_kann)
        if(_test STREQUAL "data_io")
            add_test(NAME kann.${_test} COMMAND lmx_kann_test_${_test}
                "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/kann-data-test.tsv")
        else()
            add_test(NAME kann.${_test} COMMAND lmx_kann_test_${_test})
        endif()
        set_tests_properties(kann.${_test} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 30)
    endforeach()
    if(_kann_use_pthreads)
        target_compile_definitions(lmx_kann_test_forward_gradient PRIVATE LMX_KANN_TEST_PTHREADS=1)
    endif()
endif()

if(LMX_BUILD_EXAMPLES)
    add_executable(lmx_kann_example "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/examples/train_line.c")
    lmx_c99_target(lmx_kann_example)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_kann_example PRIVATE LMX::kann)
endif()
